6234-the-battle-of-the-strong-a-romance-.description: A book by Gilbert Parker. "Tcheche--what's that?" said Ranulph. But Dormy was not to uncover his pot of roses till his own time. "That connetable's got no more wit than a square bladed knife," he rattled on. "But gache-a-penn, I'm hungry!" And as he ran he began munching a lump of bread he took from his pocket.

arxiv-2205-08709.title: Geometric approach for the modified second generation time delay interferometry
arxiv-2205-08709.creator: Pan-Pan Wang 1, Wei-Liang Qian 2,3,4, Yu-Jie Tan 1, Han-Zhong Wu 1, Cheng-Gang Shao 1
arxiv-2205-08709.description: Abstract The time delay interferometry (TDI) is an algorithm proposed to suppress the laser frequency noise in space-borne gravitational wave detectors. As a post-processing technique, it is implemented by constructing a virtual equal arm interferometer through an appropriate combination of the time-shifted data streams.

arxiv-2304-10667.title: Observation of self-oscillating supersonic flow across an acoustic horizon in two dimensions
arxiv-2304-10667.creator: Hikaru Tamura, Sergei Khlebnikov, Cheng-An Chen, Chen-Lung Hung
arxiv-2304-10667.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Hikaru Tamura, Sergei Khlebnikov, Cheng-An Chen, Chen-Lung Hung. Understanding the dynamics and stability of transonic flows in quantum fluids, especially for those beyond one spatial dimension, is an outstanding challenge, with applications ranging from nonlinear optics and condensed matter to analogue gravity. One intriguing possibility is that a system with a spatially bounded supersonic flow may evolve into a self-oscillating state that periodically emits solitons, in a process originating from the well-known Landau instability.

arxiv-2311-00390.title: A Modular Pneumatic Soft Gripper Design for Aerial Grasping and Landing*
arxiv-2311-00390.creator: Hiu Ching Cheung, Ching-Wei Chang, Bailun Jiang, Chih-Yung Wen, Henry K. Chu
arxiv-2311-00390.description: Abstract Aerial robots have garnered significant attention due to their potential applications in various industries, such as inspection, search and rescue, and drone delivery. Successful missions often depend on the ability of these robots to grasp and land effectively. This paper presents a novel modular soft gripper design tailored explicitly for aerial grasping and landing operations.

arxiv-2406-16219.title: Towards a Formal Foundation for Blockchain ZK Rollups
arxiv-2406-16219.creator: Stefanos Chaliasos, Denis Firsov, Benjamin Livshits
arxiv-2406-16219.description: Abstract . Blockchains like Bitcoin and Ethereum have revolutionized digital transactions, yet scalability issues persist. Layer 2 solutions, such as validity proof Rollups (ZK-Rollups), aim to address these challenges by processing transactions off-chain and validating them on the main chain.

arxiv-2408-15951.title: General position problems in strong and lexicographic products of graphs
arxiv-2408-15951.creator: Pakanun Dokyeesun, Sandi Klavžar, Dorota Kuziak, Jing Tian
arxiv-2408-15951.description: Abstract Outer, dual, and total general position sets are studied on strong and lexicographic products of graphs. Sharp lower and upper bounds are proved for the outer and the dual general position number of strong products and several exact values are obtained.

arxiv-2411-06382.title: Hardware-in-the-Loop for Characterization of Embedded State Estimation for Flying Microrobots
arxiv-2411-06382.creator: Aryan Naveen \affilnum 1, Jalil Morris \affilnum 1, Christian Chan \affilnum 1, Daniel Mhrous \affilnum 1, E. Farrell Helbling \affilnum 2, Nak-Seung Patrick Hyun \affilnum 3, Gage Hills \affilnum 1, and Robert J. Wood \affilnum 1
arxiv-2411-06382.description: Abstract Autonomous flapping-wing micro-aerial vehicles (FWMAV) have a host of potential applications such as environmental monitoring, artificial pollination, and search and rescue operations. One of the challenges for achieving these applications is the implementation of an onboard sensor suite due to the small size and limited payload capacity of FWMAVs.

arxiv-2412-01942.title: Cryptographic Keywords in NVD: Statistics and Visualization
arxiv-2412-01942.creator: Martin Stanek
arxiv-2412-01942.description: Abstract A preliminary attempt to use cryptographic keywords and analyze vulnerabilities published in the National Vulnerability Database is presented. Basic statistics and visualizations are included. Keywords: Cryptography, Vulnerability, NVD 1 Introduction Cryptography plays an important role in securing information systems, networks, and other IT services.

pmc-10580107.creator: Sumit Agarwal, Pulak Ghosh, Changwei Zhan
pmc-10580107.description: This cohort study analyzes credit and debit card transactions for foods purchased at branded restaurants or fast food chains before and after implementation of a fat tax in Kerala state and 9 major cities in India. Introduction Globally, more than 1 billion people have obesity, according to the World Health Organization.

pmc-10623642.title: Thrombotic thrombocytopaenic purpura in the era of HIV: A single-centre experience
pmc-10623642.creator: Yusuf Moola, Zaheera Cassimjee, Chandni Dayal, Sheetal Chiba, Adekunle Ajayi, Malcolm Davies
pmc-10623642.description: BackgroundThrombotic thrombocytopaenia purpura (TTP) is a rare disorder which carries a high mortality. HIV is an important cause of TTP.ObjectivesWe assessed the presentation and response to plasma exchange (PEX) by HIV status.MethodA single-centre retrospective review of all patients receiving PEX for TTP between 01 January 2010 and 31 December 2019 was undertaken.

pmc-10736834.title: HEARING INTERVENTION TO REDUCE COGNITIVE DECLINE: DESIGN AND FINDINGS OF THE ACHIEVE RANDOMIZED CONTROLLED TRIAL
pmc-10736834.creator: Jennifer Deal, Nicholas Reed, Luigi Ferrucci
pmc-10736834.description: Epidemiologic data consistently link age-related hearing loss with accelerated cognitive decline and incident dementia in large, population-based studies. Mechanistic pathways that could underlie this association include the effects of distorted peripheral encoding of sound on cognitive load, changes to brain structure/function, and/or reduced social engagement and increased loneliness.

pmc-11293723.title: Carbon system state determines warming potential of emissions
pmc-11293723.creator: Alexander J. Winkler, Ranga Myneni, Christian Reimers, Markus Reichstein, Victor Brovkin, Yangyang Xu, Yangyang Xu, Yangyang Xu, Yangyang Xu
pmc-11293723.description: Current strategies to hold surface warming below a certain level, e. g., 1.5 or 2°C, advocate limiting total anthropogenic cumulative carbon emissions to ∼0.9 or ∼1.25 Eg C (1018 grams carbon), respectively. These allowable emission budgets are based on a near-linear relationship between cumulative emissions and warming identified in various modeling efforts.

pmc-11622367.title: Covalent Labeling Automated Data Analysis Platform for High Throughput in R (coADAPTr): A Proteome-Wide Data Analysis Platform for Covalent Labeling Experiments
pmc-11622367.creator: Raquel
pmc-11622367.description: Covalent labeling methods coupled to mass spectrometry have emerged in recent years for studying the higher order structure of proteins. Quantifying the extent of modification of proteins in multiple states (i.e., ligand free vs ligand-bound) can provide information on protein interaction sites and regions of conformational change.

pmc-12524767.title: Necrotizing Enterocolitis: What’s New and What’s Next?
pmc-12524767.creator: Cuilee Sha, William R. Sander, Kathryn Bass, Helen Hsieh, Agnieszka B. Bialkowska
pmc-12524767.description: Necrotizing enterocolitis (NEC) is a significant cause of morbidity and mortality for preterm infants in the neonatal intensive care unit. From the first surgical approaches for NEC in the 1970s and the development of Bell’s staging criteria, there has been a continuous medical and scientific journey towards understanding the pathophysiology, clinical progression, and treatment possibilities for this devastating disease.

pmc-13083872.title: The impact of ERAP1 inhibition on metabolite homeostasis of melanoma cells
pmc-13083872.creator: Aroosha Raja, Martha Nikopaschou, Joke H. de Boer, Jeannette Ossewaarde-van Norel, Anna Artati, Michael Witting, Efstratios Stratikos, Jonas J. W. Kuiper
pmc-13083872.description: Manipulation of the activity of Endoplasmic Reticulum AminoPeptidase 1 (ERAP1) has emerged as a powerful tool for the modulation of the cellular antigenicity and concomitant adaptive immune responses, with potential applications in cancer immunotherapy and Major Histocompatibility class (MHC)-associated autoimmunity being explored. Small molecule inhibitors often target allosteric sites of ERAP1 to achieve superior selectivity.

pmc-13208390.title: Predictors of Postoperative Complications in Metabolic and Bariatric Surgery: A Retrospective Analysis Using Multivariable Logistic Regression
pmc-13208390.creator: Gon Shoham, Shira Naveh, Tariq Zoabi, Noa Gosher, Nir Messer, Jonathan B. Yuval, Mati Shnell, Adam Abu-Abeid
pmc-13208390.description: Background and Objectives: Metabolic and bariatric surgery is the most effective long-term intervention for severe obesity, associated with significant reductions in weight, associated medical problems, and cancer risk. While the overall safety profile of metabolic and bariatric surgery has improved, early postoperative complications still occur and may lead to prolonged hospitalization, reintervention, or increased morbidity.

pmc-13476555.title: Aptamer-based nanoparticle drug delivery system designed for targeting GPC3-positive liver cancer
pmc-13476555.creator: Hongxin Zhou, Shuangshuang Dong, Zhan Si, Hao Niu, Jianwen Mao, Yiran Chen, Yuhuan Li, Weizhong Wu
pmc-13476555.description: Nucleic acid aptamers, short single-stranded DNA (ssDNA) or RNA molecules generated via systematic evolution of ligands by exponential enrichment (SELEX), have emerged as promising alternatives to traditional antibodies owing to their exceptional specificity and affinity. These unique properties render them invaluable tools in both scientific research and clinical theranostics.
